evidence.note: Blue appears only in navigation/focus chrome: the '09 · INSIGHTS' eyebrow, the active 'Insights' nav pill and the progress rule; the title is dark ink, not a role colour.
The blurred background diagram keeps blue for normal paths and red for a few alarm/loss nodes and a legend swatch; no red is used for emphasis elsewhere.
All three insight cards use neutral ink for headings, body, quotes and source links; blue appears only as small bullet markers, applied identically on every card.
No red, amber or loss colour is used on any heading, text or decoration across steps 1-3.

rationale: The alarm and loss colours appear only inside the backdrop diagram, where they keep their semantic meaning. The accent blue is limited to the focus and navigation chrome (eyebrow, active nav, progress) and to uniform list markers, which is a mild but conventional accent use rather than a role colour borrowed for another role. No role colour carries text emphasis or a mismatched meaning, so the pass descriptor fits.
